reason: Req 2 is unimplemented: `sanitize_markdown_link(label, url)` is absent. Req 1 also requires rejecting URLs containing control characters, but `is_safe_url` strips those characters before validation, so a URL such as `https://example.org/a\nb` can be accepted after normalization.
target_issue: T05 Req 2; T05 Req 1 control-character rejection
thoughts: I’ll inspect the patch and its surrounding module/tests to verify the safety rules and legacy compatibility rather than relying only on the reported test run.

The patch adds `is_safe_url`, but omits the required `sanitize_markdown_link` function entirely. It also removes control characters before validation, so a URL containing embedded control bytes can be accepted after normalization, contrary to the rejection requirement.

The reported tests pass, but they cover only the legacy helper and one scheme check. The PR omits required `sanitize_markdown_link` behavior and silently strips control bytes before checking safety, allowing malformed URLs to be accepted.
